preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a space-separated sequence of integers.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 2 and all(len(line.strip().split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly two integers t and n (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5; 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^3), and each of the next t lines contains exactly two integers ai and bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ 10^16, ai ≠ bi).

preconditions.expression: t, n := map(int, stdin.splitlines()[0].strip().split()) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**16 for x in [ai, bi] for ai, bi in [tuple(map(int, line.strip().split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: All vertex numbers ai and bi in queries are within the valid range [1, |D(n)|], and ai ≠ bi for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == t and stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().isdigit() for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each query, and each line is a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()) <= |D(n)| - 1 for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each query (ai, bi), the output is a non-negative integer representing the shortest path length between ai and bi in D(n), where |D(n)| is the number of vertices in D(n).

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()) == shortest_path(ai, bi, n) for i in range(t) for ai, bi in [tuple(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1+i].strip().split())) for i in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each query (ai, bi), the output is the shortest path length between ai and bi in D(n), where shortest_path(ai, bi, n) is the minimal number of edges in any path from ai to bi in the Doe graph D(n).
